fields.T_half_s: half-life in seconds (Infinity for practically stable)
fields.parent: parent nuclide name, if a daughter in a chain
fields.daughters: list of immediate daughters with relevant gamma emission
fields.chain: identifier of the decay chain (Th-232, U-238, U-235)
fields.is_cascade: true if cascade emitter (TCS-affected at close geometry)
fields.ic_xrays: K X-rays from internal conversion of the metastable daughter, [E_keV, I_percent]
fields.tcs_type: Optional. True coincidence summing classification. One of 'chain_progeny' (natural decay chain member; TCS in close geometry), 'calibration_source' (cascade emitter used as calibration standard), 'single_line' (no significant TCS expected). Absent for nuclides not yet classified.
fields.roles: array of taxonomy v2 roles (Clean Taxonomy 2026-06-07): one or more of {'norm_primordial', 'cosmogenic', 'chernobyl_legacy', 'fresh_fission_short', 'fresh_fission_medium', 'fresh_fission_actinide', 'medical_diagnostic', 'medical_therapeutic', 'calibration_primary', 'calibration_secondary', 'calibration_rare', 'calibration_low_energy'}. Cross-role nuclides have multiple values (e.g. Cs-137 = ['chernobyl_legacy', 'calibration_primary', 'fresh_fission_medium']). Beta-pure nuclides (Sr-90/Y-90/Sr-89/Pm-147) deliberately omitted from library — no gamma signal.
fields.tenorm_relevant: true for industrial-NORM relevant entries (fly ash / phosphate / zircon / oil-pipe scale matrices). Set per brief F-LIB-EXTENSION 2026-06-07: K-40, Th-232, Tl-208, Ra-226, Bi-214, Pb-210.
fields.decay_modes: array of dominant decay modes >0.1%: {'alpha', 'beta_minus', 'beta_plus', 'ec', 'it', 'sf'}. Dominant branch first.

_schema.sources: γ-lines from IAEA Live Chart API (https://www-nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/data) — fetched 2026-06-01. T_half_s / chain / daughters / ic_xrays: статически из 03b_nuclide_library.md + LSRM library.
_schema.scope: Working set for gamma-spectrum-analysis skill: natural background, common calibration sources, common contamination/medical isotopes.

changelog.change: F-LIB-EXTENSION: applied operator-locked Clean Taxonomy v2. Backfilled roles/tenorm_relevant/chain/parent/daughters on 31 existing entries per operator-locked table (2026-06-07). Created Ra-228 (was missing). Restored physically-correct chain back-references (Th-228 parent: Ra-228 -> Ac-228; Pb-210 parent: Bi-214 -> Po-214; Ra-226 daughters: [Pb-214,Bi-214] -> [Rn-222]; Pb-214 parent: Rn-222 -> Po-218). Refined role vocabulary: norm_cosmogenic -> cosmogenic (Be-7, Na-22); fresh_fission -> fresh_fission_short (I-131), fresh_fission_medium (Cs-137, Cs-134); calibration_rare -> calibration_secondary (Cs-134); calibration_primary -> calibration_low_energy (Am-241). Ti-44/Sc-44 chain field cleared (not a NORM chain, was incorrectly set). IAEA-fetched lines and T_half_s untouched.

Ra-228._note: Pure beta-minus, no gamma lines above ~13.5 keV (NaI detector cutoff). Lines deliberately empty. T_half = 5.75 y per NNDC NuDat 3.0.
